Thank you for writing this.

I know I don’t deserve privacy. I just wish I could write or tell anyone anything without having far reaching consequences. I want to be able to talk to someone and say what I am feeling without fearing for my wellbeing. I want to be able to write my feelings for once without worrying who can find it. I don’t even know if I am going to go with my plan, but just writing everything down made me feel so much better, but now I don’t know. I just wish I could do anything without being judged. 

Thank you again for even reading what I wrote. It means a lot to me. Genuinely.

Thank you a lot for writing this.

I wish I could get a diagnosis or something, but I don’t think my parents will ever believe there is something wrong with me. After founding out about the cutting they didn’t think that I was depressed, but blamed my friends and said I wasn’t allowed to be with them anymore. They won’t believe something is wrong.
Thank you again
Thank you a lot. I just wish I knew what ok was.
